en.headline: Police arrest employer after suspected illegal worker found dead in Mai Po fish pond
en.dek: A 37-year-old mainland man was discovered in a fish pond in the early hours of Monday; a 70-year-old operator was held over alleged illegal employment.
body: Police have arrested a 70-year-old fish-pond operator on suspicion of employing a person not lawfully employable after a 37-year-old mainland man was found dead in a fish pond in Mai Po, Yuen Long, early on Monday.

Officers said the operator, surnamed Tung, reported losing contact with the man, surnamed Wang, on Sunday evening. Rescue teams found Wang’s body in the pond off Tam Kon Chau Road at about 4.30am on Monday. He was certified dead at the scene.

Preliminary investigations indicated Wang, an air-conditioning technician who had entered Hong Kong on a two-way permit, was suspected of working illegally for Tung. Police classified the case as a body found and employing a person not lawfully employable. An autopsy will determine the cause of death; officers said no suspicious circumstances had been noted so far.
The Border District crime squad is handling the investigation. Wang’s wife on the mainland had earlier reported losing contact with him.
Under the Immigration Ordinance, employing a person not lawfully employable is a serious offence.

zh.headline: 米埔魚塘發現屍體 僱主涉聘用非法勞工被捕
zh.dek: 37歲內地男子周一凌晨被發現倒臥魚塘，70歲魚塘經營者被警方以涉嫌聘用不可合法受僱人士拘捕。
body: 警方已拘捕一名70歲魚塘經營者，涉嫌聘用不可合法受僱人士。一名37歲內地男子周一凌晨在元朗米埔魚塘被發現死亡。
警方表示，該名姓董經營者周日晚上報案，指失去與姓王男子聯絡。救援人員於周一凌晨約4時30分在擔竿洲路附近魚塘發現王氏屍體，當場證實死亡。
初步調查顯示，王氏是冷氣技工，持雙程證來港，涉嫌在董氏的魚塘非法工作。警方將案件列為「屍體發現」及「聘用不可合法受僱人士」。警方稱目前未發現可疑情況，死因有待解剖確定。
案件由邊境警區重案組跟進。王氏在內地的妻子早前已報失聯絡。
根據《入境條例》，聘用不可合法受僱人士屬嚴重罪行。
